subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Small
solution:
The correct answer is option no. i.e. **'Slight'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **slight** means very small, not important or serious.

 
 
• **Example:- **There is **slight** chance of rain.
 
 
 
• The word **small** means not large in size, number, amount etc.
 
 
• **Example:-** They live in a** small **house.
 
 
 
• As both the words **Slight (छोटा) and Small(छोटा)** are similar in meaning.

**Therefore, the correct answer is option(4)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Other options are:-**

 
 
• **Rich- **Having a lot of money or property.**(धनी)**
 
• **Adequate- **Enough for what you need.**(पर्याप्त)**
 
• **Liberal- **Accepting different opinions or kinds of behaviour.**(सहिष्णु)**
